notes.title: New update is now live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290596/90aca693895fc2b0afc417046bbbd54ad2b28be6.png[/img]

A new batch of tweaks and fixes is now ready on Steam! Make sure our game is up to date 🧟

⬇️Read the patch notes below⬇️

- Translation fixes
- Fixed the player not taking damage penalty from killing scientist when having invulnerability status
- Fixed life-up popup not showing up when given medkit during the cutscene
- Added a list of voice-over actors in credits
- Added options to change blood color
- Fixed life bonus not being applied correctly after completing level
- Fixed creature sounds messing up when changing selection quickly in Bestiary
- Other minor tweaks
